name: fill_bonus_tokens
description: fill_bonus_tokens(accept_tokens, accept_lens, bonus_tokens, accept_stride) -> out. accept_tokens is a two-dimensional token table with row stride accept_stride, accept_lens is an integer [B] tensor of per-row lengths in [1, accept_stride], and bonus_tokens is [B] and is used only as the dtype/device template. For each row i, select accept_tokens.reshape(-1)[i*accept_stride + accept_lens[i] - 1] and cast it to bonus_tokens.dtype. Returns a newly allocated [B] tensor. No input is mutated. The native kernels use accept_tokens/accept_lens contiguous copies and the supplied accept_stride; the exercised dtype is int64.
